description: Synthetic sesslint.checks package barrel parity (__all__ name list and order from the pinned checks/__init__.py; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-checks-submodule-apis: accounting, checkpoint, graph, hygiene, identity, ordering, size, tool_pairing_1, and tool_pairing_2 have dedicated module parity vectors; exercising those entry points is not barrel coverage.
GAP-checks-compute-finding-fingerprint: Python checks.__all__ re-exports compute_finding_fingerprint from sesslint.finding; the Rust checks crate barrel does not surface that name.
GAP-checks-tool-kinds: Python checks.__all__ lists TOOL_KINDS from tool_pairing_2; the Rust checks crate barrel omits TOOL_KINDS.
GAP-checks-export-order: Rust lib.rs groups re-exports by submodule; Python __all__ uses a different name order (vectors record the Python order).
